card.name: Micro units and every-other-day phrasing
card.fires_on: The 'mc' or 'c' piece of microgram/microliter units right after a number (mcg, mcL), and the word after 'every' such as 'second' or 'other' in dosing intervals.

modes.label: Micro unit start
modes.description: The first piece of mcg or mcL written after a number in a dose or blood count.
modes.example: a loading infusion of one<< mc>>g/kg over 10 minutes.

modes.label: Every other interval
modes.description: The word 'second' or 'other' after 'every' in a dosing schedule.
modes.example: 500 mL may be given every<< second>> or third day during the period of risk

card.plain: It marks the 'mc' in mcg or mcL after a number, and 'other' or 'second' in 'every other day' style schedules.
